notes.title: We’re thrilled to announce - Bureau of Contacts is officially out in Version 1.0
notes.content:
Release Patch Notes:

Emotional Adaptability & Tone Awareness
– AI now responds more accurately based on defined personality traits like aggression, cynicism, or mystery.
– Shows emotional "softening" when treated with empathy or respect - offers clearer, more cooperative replies while keeping the eerie vibe.

Improved Clues for Personal Info Discovery
– Every hint now delivers a concrete, measurable detail (letter, digit, historical fact).
– Repeated questions produce varied responses to reduce repetition and enhance discovery.
– Removed poetic ambiguity - replies are now direct and precise.

Compact & Efficient Answers
– Replies limited to 1- 2 sentences for a concise, responsive dialogue experience.
– Removed unnecessary descriptions - every line delivers essential information only.

Reduced Repetition
– System tracks previously given info and avoids repeating it.
– Correct player guesses receive short confirmations, cleanly wrapping up a topic.

Atmosphere Preservation
– Despite being more concise, dialogue retains the ghost's ominous, mysterious tone.
– AI stays true to its defined character, ensuring consistent and immersive interaction.

Game Optimization Improvements
– Improved overall performance and loading speed.
– Reduced latency during cooperative gameplay.

notes.title: New update 0.0.4.0 brings the Bunker location!

[previewyoutube=th8uw9EbzEw;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Update 0.0.4.0 - NEW LOCATION and various improvements
notes.content:
Greetings, dear players! We are pleased to present you with a major update, which includes an extensive list of changes and improvements.

[h3]Important:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a new location - Bunker!
[*] For the convenience of players, the Ghost's responses are duplicated in the text chat.
[*] Also, the Ghost's responses when disabling generative AI have been improved. The alternative voiceover of the Ghost, which works when disabling generative AI, has been improved.
[/list]

[h3]Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a visual bug with the supposed ability to add yourself infinitely in the voting when choosing a map
[*] Fixed a visual bug with a clearly visible source of player character illumination in the world
[*] Fixed the inability to exorcise the Wormhole ghost trap using the Crucifix
[*] Fixed a bug with the "Resume" button sometimes not working in the game menu
[*] Fixed the point where the player character gets stuck in the Hospital location
[*] Fixed the description of the Onryo ghost in the journal
[*] Fixed the incorrect effect of the difficulty modifier parameter - "Hunt Frequency"
[/list]

[h3]Improvements:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Interaction with some interactive objects (piano, canvas, record player) in the location slightly increases the aggressiveness of the Ghost, affecting its danger.
[*] The Ghost (based on generative AI) has a better understanding of its current mood, which changes throughout the session, and therefore can influence its responses, decisions, and actions.
[*] The Ghost can now interact with interactive objects that it previously could not (music player, piano)
[*] Banishing the Ghost's traps now partially restores the player character's Sanity
[*] Banishing the Ghost fully restores the player character's Sanity
[/list]

[h3]Changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Decreased the strength of the visual effect of the fish eye when Sanity decreases
[*] Increased the effectiveness of Sanity restoration after using Sedatives
[*] Increased the frequency of the ghost trap - Wormhole
[*] Significantly improved and simplified circle recognition when creating a Circle of Salt
[*] Added an echo (reverberation) effect to the Hospital location
[/list]

Thank you for your feedback and support and enjoy the game!

notes.title: Game Difficulty Settings Are Here!
notes.content:
We’re excited to bring you a highly anticipated feature: [b]Game Difficulty Settings![/b]
 
Alongside this major addition, we’ve made some key improvements to make your journey through the game even more immersive and enjoyable.

Game Difficulty Settings:

[list]
[*] Customizable Experience: Tailor your gameplay with 15 adjustable parameters to fit your style.
[*] Preset Levels: Choose from Easy, Normal, or Hard presets for a ready-made experience.
[*] Personalized Presets: Craft and save up to 3 custom difficulty settings directly in your profile.
[*] Reward Impact: The difficulty level you select now influences the value of the rewards you earn, making each decision count.
[/list]

[list]

[/list]

Ready to test your limits? Jump back in and experience the thrill with the new difficulty options!

Coldness on your skin...
Heart palpitations...

Is that what you're after? Then you've come to the right place.

notes.title: Update 0.0.2.0 - New map, fixes and changes
notes.content:
Good day, dear players. The big update is already here!

[h3]New features:[/h3]
[list]
[*] A new map has been added - Hospital (more details in the extended news for the update).
[*] Added an option to enable/disable speech recognition, so that players whose CPU does not meet the minimum requirements can play. Communication with the ghost can be done using the in-game text chat (T key). In addition, thanks to the crash report processing system, statistics have been collected on processors that are not compatible with Open AI Whisper, which is used as speech recognition software, and based on these statistics, the game automatically disables speech recognition with a corresponding notification and the subsequent ability to reactivate speech recognition by the player at their own risk. It is worth noting that the option to communicate with the ghost via text chat is available even when speech recognition is enabled.
[/list]

[h3]Changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Previously, for exorcism, the tool had to be placed in the rune. Now this procedure has been brought to the original idea and now the tools (crucifix, lamp, etc.) must be held in hands. The corresponding instructions in the training and in the journal have also been updated.
[*] Since some players had difficulty reading notes in the training, the camera has been linked to notes for reading, similar to the boards in the Lobby.
[*] The text of the description of the camera in the store has been supplemented. Now the description indicates that you can take pictures to get an additional reward.
[*] The accounting of photos in the session results has been debugged. Now the camera does not count more rewards than it should. That is, out of 8 available photos, only photos with unique objects are counted. In this regard, the price of the camera has been reduced from 250 to 125 and the number of experience points given for unique objects photographed has been increased.
[*] One crucifix has been included in the list of free equipment. Thus, the crucifix is ​​always available in the game, even for new players who do not meet the level for purchasing it.
[/list]

[h3]Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed the collision of the floor in the trailer - now physical objects do not jump or fall through it.
[*] Multiple edits to the geometry of the House on the Hill and Office (Lobby) levels.
[*] Fixed the burning of the crucifix in the inventory. Now the crucifix does not react to traps and the ghost from the inventory, but works as described in the store.
[*] Fixed the appearance of the plug for the electrical panel in the eye socket of the skull.
[*] Fixed the text in the tablet with the results of the match.
[*] Fixed the implementation of the gaze inversion. Now only the vertical axis is inverted. The corresponding description of the option in the settings menu has also been fixed.
[/list]

Thank you for your support and feedback and enjoy the game!

notes.title: No more limits for the ghost requests!
notes.content:
The good news for most "Bureau of Contacts" players came with today's update - after weeks of monitoring, we decided to make spirit requests in the game unlimited.

No bundles.
No more limits on interaction with the ghost. 
No any in-game transactions in the game, as before.

In case of any force majeure on the part of our partners, the current generative AI system automatically switches to an analog AI system to allow you to continue receiving full gaming experience.
Such a switch ([i]if it happens[/i]) will be reflected for players in only 2 nuances: 
[list]
[*] the ghost’s voice will be changed; 
[*] the ghost will communicate with you using classic key phrases, i.e. he will talk strictly to the point.
[/list]

We continue to keep our finger on the pulse and monitor the use of this component of the game to prevent any malicious actions.

Thank you for your feedback, which helps us to make "Bureau of Contacts" better and better. 
Welcome to Steam-discussions and [url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.gg%2FFjrP9Ex]our Discord[/url] to be always in touch.

We read you. We hear you. Our ghost is watching you!

notes.title: Hotfix 0.0.1.8 - Limit on interactions with the ghost is completely removed
notes.content:
We are grateful to our caring community, which quickly helps us to find the most painful points and faster improve the game.

Your numerous feedback and several weeks of monitoring your interactions with our GenAI-driven ghost allowed us to make an important decision regarding the existing limit on the number of spiritual requests (interactions with a ghost).

With this fix, [b]limit on interactions with the ghost is completely removed[/b].


[h3]What does this mean for players?[/h3]

1) Players, as before, will not have to make any payments to fully enjoy the game except the only one-time payment - game price.
There are not, have not been and will not be any in-game transactions in the game.

2) In case of any force majeure on the part of our partners, the current generative AI system automatically switches to an analog AI system to allow you a continued full gaming experience.
Such a switch (if it happens) will be reflected for players in only 2 nuances: the ghost’s voice will change; the ghost will communicate with you using classic key phrases, i.e. strictly to the point.

As before, we continue to keep our finger on the pulse and monitor the use of this component of the game to prevent any malicious actions.

Thank you for being with us and helping us make "Bureau of Contacts" better and better from the very beginning of development to this day.


[h3]P.S. Bonus updates[/h3]

Changes:
[list]
[*] Increased the chance of turning off the light during the Hunt
[*] During the hunt, it is impossible to interact with the electricity panel.
[/list]

Fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed the sound of the ghost, made it quieter and increased the radius.
[*] Fixed a crash with the eye trap when the player falls under its influence.
[*] Fixed a crash when screaming from the ghost.
[*] Fixed a bug where the Ghost does not see the player through doorways
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix 0.0.1.7
notes.content:
We are pleased to introduce a new batch of much-needed updates, including re-fixes of previously encountered issues based on your feedback, as well as adding some new features to the game.

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved crash report tracking system. Now the crash reporter sends information directly to the developers in the analytical system for processing. In this regard, we ask you to fully use the crash reporter functionality, in particular, we strongly ask you to fill in the field with additional information about what you were doing at the time of the crash. This will improve communication between players and developers and help us better understand the problems you are experiencing.
[*] Reworked the logic for processing graphics settings, which caused a crash from the very start of the game. Now, when you first start the game or reset the settings, there is no auto-detection of the settings (which caused a huge load on the PC), but a static preset of settings is set. Auto-detection of settings, however, is brought out as an option in the graphics settings and calibrated in such a way as not to overestimate the settings.
[*] The default frame rate limit settings are set to 60 frames per second to prevent potential overheating of the graphics adapter. However, anyone can change or completely disable this limit at their own discretion.
[*] Reduced frequency of switching off the electrical panel by the Ghost outside the Hunt
[*] When the Hunt starts, the electrical panel will not be switched off with 100% probability
[*] After the Hunt is completed, if the electrical panel was switched on before the Hunt, the electrical panel will be switched on again (now the light will not switch off so often)
[/list]

[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed the ability to run out of the Location at the beginning of the Hunt. Now the front door closes before the start of the Hunt.
[*] Fixed: the volume parameters did not adjust the volume of some sounds. (note: If you encounter and find this problem with some sounds, be sure to let us know so that we can fix it)
[/list]

[b]Innovations:[/b]
[list]
[*] Control hints: adaptive hints for control buttons have been added to the game, depending on the context. For example, depending on what object you are looking at, or what object you are holding in your hands.
[*] Added door slam. Now, if you abruptly lock the doors, it can attract the Ghost.
[*] Added additional sound effects to the Ghost during the Hunt, which will help determine its presence near you.
[/list]

Thank you for your support and enjoy the game!

notes.title: How does a neural network-driven ghost work?
notes.content:
We've been receiving messages from players who are intrigued that "Bureau of Contacts" will feature the possibility of being killed by a neural network for the first time, but also questioning - how is this possible?

Indeed, this is the first time that generative technology has been used in a game in such a way as to control behavior based on players' words and actions.

Think back to what good old traditional AI was like - a large set of scripts and a bit of randomization magic yielded a well-designed set of conditions and possible outputs. 
That's how it used to be, already 15 years ago...

In our case, we use not that classical, but a generative model that can realize not only content, but also meaning. In other words, the ghosts in the game:
[list]
[*] analyze context;
[*] simulate moods and attitudes towards what they hear/occur; 
[*] make decisions on their own will and reasoning, parodying human behavior and "cause and effect relationships".
[/list]
All of this is realized to the extent of how well the model is trained and how powerful the neural network is.
 
In other words, in "Bureau of Contacts" you will have to watch your words, because you will not only get a meaningful response for these words, but may also be subjected to appropriate "actions" if IT think you deserve it.

Let's look at one possible reaction to the provocation:
[previewyoutube=X5pOP8YBAeQ;full][/previewyoutube]
